column1: # What Morpheus (perseids-tools/morpheus, commit ab6898ffed335fc6169fa02c9940657a9b5a78e0, MPL-2.0) printed for the seven forms of Gen 1 and Ps 22 that
# layers 1 and 2 leave with no candidate (tests/unit/lxx-morpheus.test.ts): form, then the <NL> segments of its Perseus-format output in beta code, one after another.
# CAPTURED from the real image (story mw-u2w5klk.14): docker build -t lampas-morpheus https://github.com/perseids-tools/morpheus.git#ab6898ffed335fc6169fa02c9940657a9b5a78e0,
# then the forms in beta code (toBeta, scripts/lxx/morpheus.ts), one to a line, on the standard input of: docker run --rm -i -e MORPHLIB=stemlib lampas-morpheus bin/cruncher -S
# ⇥ stands for the tab Morpheus prints inside a segment. A form Morpheus does not know has no output line at all (it is said on standard error) and an empty second column here.

# ζωσῶν is known (a present participle, and a doric future one the mapping leaves out); ἐλίπανας is not known to it; αὐταί is αὐτός declined as an adjective (art_adj), a pronoun the mapping leaves out;
# καταδιώξεται has a second, epic-only subjunctive reading that is left unmapped.
